$schema: W3C Design Tokens draft shape ($value, $type, $description); leaves may carry $min, $max, $unit. Flattened to dotted names by tools/make-skin-tokens.mjs.
$description: Strategy Premium: the tokens of the tile skin. Edit a $value, run node studio/build.mjs, reload. Lengths are CSS px at 1x. Colours are #rrggbb.

hi.$description: Union fabric, lit end of the gradient (top)

lo.$description: Union fabric, shaded end of the gradient (bottom)

strip.$description: Union hoist band (the dark band that carries the arm or echelon sign)

hi.$description: Confederate fabric, lit end of the gradient (top)

lo.$description: Confederate fabric, shaded end of the gradient (bottom)

hi.$description: Contested side fabric, lit end (a unit whose side is not decided is gold, never a side colour)

inkOnGold.$description: Text on the contested gold fabric

keyline.$description: Dark outer hairline under every mark (separation on bright ground)

bone.$description: Light keyline of a unit mark (separation on dark ground)

carriedGrey.$description: The neutral a carried-forward mark is mixed toward

gaugeTrack.$description: Empty part of the strength line

ring.$description: Air between the body and the footprint edge; the selection ring lives here

radius.$description: The one corner radius of every mark

hairline.$description: The one line weight (keylines, trim); selection uses 1.5x

h0.$description: Body height of a regiment or battery mark

h1.$description: Body height of a battalion mark

h2.$description: Body height of a brigade standard

h3.$description: Body height of a division standard

h4.$description: Body height of a corps standard

hAgg.$description: Body height of a crowd (formation) mark

hoist0.$description: Width of the hoist band of a unit mark

hoist1.$description: Width of the hoist band of a formation standard

padL.$description: Space between the hoist band and the text

padR.$description: Space between the text and the fly edge

fly.$description: Depth of the fly edge shape (notch for the Union, point for the Confederacy)

nameLine.$description: Height added when the full name unfolds under the code (the last 4 px of it are the strength line)

stack.$description: Offset of each banner behind a crowd mark

nameZoom0.$description: Zoom at which names begin to unfold into the marks

nameZoom1.$description: Zoom at which names are fully unfolded

family.$value: "Barlow Semi Condensed", "Bahnschrift SemiCondensed", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
family.$description: Face of every mark (open licence: SIL OFL 1.1, bundled)

unitSize.$description: Type size 1: unit codes, names and the second line (11 px is the floor of the language)

formSize.$description: Type size 2: formation marks (standards and crowd marks) and their counts

formWeight.$description: Weight of a formation code and of every count

shadowAlpha.$description: Strength of the soft ground shadow (light from the north-west: it falls south-east)

shadowDx.$description: Horizontal offset of the ground shadow

shadowDy.$description: Vertical offset of the ground shadow

contactAlpha.$description: Strength of the tight contact shadow right under the edge

rimAlpha.$description: Strength of the light rim on the north and west edges

keyline.$description: Strength of the light keyline of a fresh unit mark (the dark hairline outside it is always there)

sheen.$description: Strength of the soft diagonal sheen across the cloth

gloss.$description: Top-light sheen over the upper half of the fabric

liftPerEchelon.$description: How far a formation standard floats above the ground per echelon (shadow grows with it)

carriedMix.$description: How far a carried-forward mark is mixed toward grey (the one provisional device)

carriedDark.$description: Extra darkening of a carried-forward mark

carriedKeyline.$description: Strength of the light keyline of a carried-forward mark

flutter.$description: Amplitude of the fly-edge flutter of a unit in transit (0 turns it off)

selectMs.$description: Selection ring and name unfold glide

growMs.$description: Glide of the hover and selection unfold of a name into the banner

flutterMs.$description: Time the fly takes to start and stop fluttering when a unit starts or stops marching

dropPx.$description: Height a mark drops from when it arrives (the arrival settle)

unfurl.$description: Share of the arrival in which the banner unfurls from the hoist
